Success pays 1.0 only on at_exit & holding_box, exactly the setup's exit condition; because the first fall (step 2-8) always precedes the earliest possible exit arrival (>= 10 forward moves across the 6x6 floor), the live success path is always a recovered u0, so 1.0 is paid only for full task compliance. Reachability: after every fall the agent is turned to face the landed box, so an immediate pickup is always available next step, and the path u0->u1->u0->...->u3 exists. Reward safety: bounded (<= 2 falls => <= 0.2 progress + 1.0 final), no negative rewards, nothing farmable (falls are exogenous and capped, and the 0.1 sits only on u1->u0), trap and final states are absorbing with default-0 loops. Coverage: irrelevant events (siren_ringing, switch_toggled, plain steps) are absorbed by per-state else self-loops in u0/u2/u3 and by the total explicit partition in u1; labels are predicate-only, drawn from the five given propositions; persistent/event distinction is respected (box_fell as trigger, holding_box/at_exit as conditions); FINAL_STATES: u3 is nonempty, declared in STATES, accepting, and reachable; format matches the paper (headers, (s,e)->s' transitions, (s,e,s')->r rewards, else listed last per state). The 0.1 per correct immediate recovery is the densest meaningful progress signal this domain's proposition set allows, and it is bounded.
